title: 耕云堂 Gengyun Tang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 6.21 m above the ground

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西為湛虛翠軒又西為耕雲堂又西為若帆之閣湛虛翠軒東數十武有闗帝廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按若帆之閣下層額曰御風泠然上額曰平臨天境與湛虛翠軒諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 北逺山村 over a stone bridge and west: 湛虛翠軒, 耕雲堂, the two-storey 若帆之閣 with a plaque per floor, and a 闗帝廟 a little to the east.

evidence.title: 耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.181, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-815
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书堂枕碧川，川水灌鳞田。目廑耕耘苦，心祈稼穑虔。益筹旸与雨，那共胝和胼。莫更屏风画，前呈七月篇。
evidence.summary: Poem 耕云堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.183, under 若帆之阁; source ref 9-102
evidence.excerpt_zh: 几架书堂俯水田，雨旸幸协稻芊芊。三庚屈指西成远，未敢先时庆有年。
evidence.summary: Poem 耕云堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1765, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 自花港观鱼放舟至耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.192, under 若帆之阁; source ref 3-99
evidence.excerpt_zh: 柳展长条桃灼华，川湄岩角灿明霞。扁舟试放溪亭北，恍似寻芳溯若耶。
evidence.summary: Poem 自花港观鱼放舟至耕云堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 由北远山村泛舟至耕云堂观水田成什
evidence.locator: v3 p.193, under 若帆之阁; source ref 3-348
evidence.excerpt_zh: 清溪曲折泛轻航，岸沚汀兰互绚芳。林幄蝉声如和答，水村农事正匆忙。三耘冒暑诚非易，百谷登场候最长。欲识田功岂学稼，豳风雅绘在山堂。
evidence.summary: Poem 由北远山村泛舟至耕云堂观水田成什 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 北远山村泛舟至耕云堂即景成什
evidence.locator: v3 p.193, under 若帆之阁; source ref 4-254
evidence.excerpt_zh: 几转溪湾到水门，扁舟缓度北山村。烟笼柳岸汀洲暗，风拂稻畦稏翻。亦有浴波遍鹅鸭，岂同留客足鸡豚。田家景物御园备，探讨民艰重本原。
evidence.summary: Poem 北远山村泛舟至耕云堂即景成什 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1810, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
